newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Merged Westpac/Trust Bank appoints advisory board.
newsitem.headline: Merged Westpac/Trust Bank appoints advisory board.

text.p: An expanded advisory board has been appointed to oversee the merged New Zealand operations of Westpac and Trust Bank, Westpac chief executive Harry Price said on Tuesday.
The members of the board are: Bryan Kensington (chairman), Ian Farrant, John King, Brent Layton, Graeme Pentecost, Sue Suckling, Wayne Walden and Peter Wilson.
Price said the new board symbolised the merger process.
"We are bringing together two strong and successful banks with long traditions of serving New Zealanders," Price said in statement.
He said membership of the new board, which included directors with experience of both Trust Bank and Westpac, gave the new bank wide regional representation within the New Zealand marketplace.
